name: Oppai Tsuma ~Takabisha H-Cup Kazama Akemi~
original_name: オッパイ妻～高飛車Ｈカップ・風間暁美～
source:
Akemi Kazama, the boss of the underwear company "Desir" is always dressed in perfectly pressed suits.
She hasn't been very satisfied with her sex life with her husband... however what action will she takes when she finds out that he has been cheating on her?!

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE049579.html]DLsite English[/url]]
